label: AliExpress Dropshipping (DS) API / AliExpress Open Platform

discovery.auth: oauth2 (app key + secret; oauth code from the app callback (3-minute validity) → GET/POST /auth/token/create → access_token + refresh_token; /auth/token/refresh)
sdks: Official SDKs advertised on the portal ('Rich API endpoints for all eCommerce domains'); language list not readable

auth: 1. Register the platform's app on the Open Platform (category + review)
2. Tenant (AliExpress buyer / dropshipper) authorises the app → callback returns an oauth `code` (valid 3 minutes)
4. Renew with `/auth/token/refresh`; sign every call with app key + secret

endpoints.purpose: product detail, freight query, order create, order tracking, feed / recommendations
endpoints.notes: group visible in the index; method pages JS-rendered

config_fields.name: ship_to_country
config_fields.help: Two-letter destination country used for DS prices, stock and search (countryCode / ship_to_country), e.g. US.

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: Currency for search and product prices (currency / target_currency), e.g. USD.

config_fields.name: language
config_fields.help: Locale for search, product text and tracking (local / target_language / language), e.g. en_US.

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: App Key of your AliExpress Open Platform Dropshipping app (Console > App Management; https://openservice.aliexpress.com/doc/doc.htm#/?docId=1589).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: App Secret of the same app; signs every call (uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the parameters sorted by name as name+value, docId=1386). Never sent on the wire.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Buyer (dropshipper) access_token from the authorization-code exchange /auth/token/create (docId=1592). Production tokens last 30 days (expires_in 2592000); renew with /auth/token/refresh (docId=1593) and update this value — the runtime does not refresh it.

me.note: aliexpress.ds.member.benefit.get: the connected dropshipper's DS benefits ({aliexpress_ds_member_benefit_get_response: {result: [{code: 'auto-pay', title, canApply, canBenefit}]}}); an IllegalAccessToken error means the access_token expired.

list_products.note: aliexpress.ds.text.search (docId=1698): keyword search of the AliExpress DS catalogue for the configured country/currency/locale; `category` is an AliExpress categoryId (aliexpress.ds.category.get). Prices are strings in the configured currency; `id` is the product_id for get_product.

get_product.note: aliexpress.ds.product.get (docId=1790): full DS product — ae_item_base_info_dto (subject, detail HTML), ae_item_sku_info_dtos[] (sku_id, sku_attr, sku_price, offer_sale_price, sku_available_stock, currency_code), ae_multimedia_info_dto.image_urls (';'-separated), package_info_dto, logistics_info_dto, ae_store_info in `raw`. The mapped price/sku/stock are the FIRST SKU's; `sku_attr` is what create_order's items take.

create_order.note: aliexpress.ds.order.create (docId=1617) places an unpaid DS order (pay it in AliExpress or with API Pay, docId=1640). Pass `items` in AliExpress form: [{product_id, product_count, sku_attr (from get_product), logistics_service_name (a delivery option code), order_memo}] and `shipping_address` as the logistics_address object: {address, address2, city, province, country, zip, full_name, contact_person, mobile_no, phone_country, locale, cpf/tax_number where required}. Both are sent verbatim inside param_place_order_request4_open_api_d_t_o. Check `status` (is_success) and error_code (e.g. B_DROPSHIPPER_DELIVERY_ADDRESS_VALIDATE_FAIL, DELIVERY_METHOD_NOT_EXIST); `id` is the first AliExpress order id.

get_order.note: aliexpress.trade.ds.order.get (docId=1595): order_status (PLACE_ORDER_SUCCESS, IN_CANCEL, WAIT_SELLER_SEND_GOODS, SELLER_PART_SEND_GOODS, WAIT_BUYER_ACCEPT_GOODS, FUND_PROCESSING, FINISH, ...), logistics_status, amounts, child_order_list and logistics_info_list in `raw`. The response carries no order id, so `id` is not returned.

track.note: aliexpress.ds.order.tracking.get (docId=1660): one row per parcel {mail_no, carrier_name, cp_name, eta_time_stamps (ms), detail_node_list[{tracking_name, tracking_detail_desc, time_stamp (ms)}], package_item_list}. 'TRACKING DATA NOT FOUND' until the seller ships.

not_offered.quote_shipping: aliexpress.ds.freight.query (https://openservice.aliexpress.com/doc/doc.htm#/?docId=1597) requires queryDeliveryReq.selectedSkuId ('Selected sku (From aliexpres.product.get)', Required: Yes) besides productId, shipToCountry and quantity; the vocabulary's quote_shipping has no SKU input, so a valid request cannot be built.

adapter.terms: AliExpress Open Platform: business interfaces are called at https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/sync?method={api_path}&{query} and signed over every parameter sorted by name (docId=1385, 1386).

live_check.notes: requires app_key, app_secret, access_token, ship_to_country, currency, language; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
